title: Hearts of Iron IV family map: every nested source family, native gap and selected system
head: be24c225c00cf8c583bf7773ee124d354b91e88b

reviews.classification: full actual JSON family-map review with overlapping source inventory and native gaps preserved
reviews.disposition:
F1: Full actual content review covers all5104JSON lines through the losslessly factored header/dictionaries,54routing blocks and every I001–I156/S01–S15 record. All source paths, direct/recursive counts/bytes, prior/current status, section, remaining gap and K/P/topic/owner mappings were read. The [reconstruction receipt](../../../audits/reconciliation-2026-11-04/hoi4-family-view-receipt-b591.json) and [reading view](../../../audits/reconciliation-2026-11-04/hoi4-family-lossless-view-b591.json) retain exact parsed equality; source SHA989ecc45838fb6eb66636ac9e539d95f2a3183f8679f1729f9540c2406f1abdf remains unchanged. This is actual map review, not a source/native implementation read by proxy.

F2:156inventory rows plus15selected-system rows are171different records with overlap, not171independent mechanisms. Statuses67prior-representative/39representative-deep/4small-definition/14unread/2empty-definition/10metadata/4representative/3author-contract/4empty-placeholder/2commented-contract/5unread-native/2inventory-only sum156. No class is whole-game/runtime acceptance. Parent/child recursive file and byte totals overlap; e.g navy, doctrine, faction, MIO, peace and unit subtrees cannot be added to their parents as unique breadth. Zero direct files can coexist with recursive data; a zero-byte placeholder or commented contract does not prove the engine lacks that function or implements the comment.

F3: I001–I138 preserve source-definition scope across abilities/acclimatization/aces, authoring and AI plans/designs/scorers, UI/alerts/bookmarks, autonomy/factions/collections/characters, manufacture/equipment/resources/occupation, research/doctrine/agency/tokens, leader/scientist/awards, event/focus/raids/peace, modifiers/scripted effects/triggers/localization, units/terrain/weather and timed intent. A representative read on a folder does not establish every country alternative, actual target evaluator, modifier stacking/order, instance serialization or native phase. UI author-contract/metadata and static names are not rendered interaction, player knowledge, real awards or saved profile state. Exact counts/bytes remain dated source inventory signals.

F4: I139–I156 separately preserve broader events/history/language/interface/tutorial/script/test/document/map/sound/build/DLC surfaces and native combat/search/supply/modifier, interpreter/tick/order/RNG, serializer/migration/autosave, mod/DLC restoration and wall-clock gaps. A bundled CEF/SDK/TBB/launcher/crash reporter is supporting build, not a new gameplay system. Scripting a timer or reading a maintained-focus definition does not establish closed-tab catch-up. Save-wrapper or DLC descriptor evidence does not supply native restoration/compatibility, current ownership or an active installation. The five native-unread rows remain explicit.

F5: S01industrial learning through assigned work, S02constitution/goals/contributions, S03rights/transfer autonomy, S04materially supported occupation, S05distinct resistance/compliance/incidents, S06agency capacity, S07information access/network, S08scientist roles, S09practice versus appointments, S10climate versus terrain mastery, S11raid phases, S12staged settlement, S13career/profile awards, S14role-specific AI scoring and S15paid maintained intent are useful source-qualified comparison questions. Their names are not recovered algorithms, working YAIR consumers or permission to copy nationwide models into every local life. Actual actor/stock/source, directed rights, information channel, stage/clock, commitment and retention need their existing owners under AD38.

F6: OG1/S03, OG2/S07, OG3/S12 and OG4/S13 retain thematic-only dedicated-owner gaps in the map/report. The broad society/means/dialogue/life/save homes are real candidate routes, not proof no owner exists or a mandate for four new frameworks. A finite informant or local settlement can be useful before nation-scale implementation; stronger actual means can change ordinary reach/cost. Current PROJECT and AD36/AD42/AD43/AD51/AD52 qualify old reference order, second-consumer, human and blanket gate ideas. The map's historical live-owner statement does not verify today's path/content or source installation. Original JSON and all useful partial/unread distinctions remain intact; no source extractor, game, browser/build/test, personal save, network/acquisition, worker, migration, deletion, commit or push occurred.
reviews.evidence: All171records and54routing blocks plus every common dictionary/header read in three bounded lossless outputs; reconstruction equality/source identity recorded in hoi4-family-view-receipt-b591.json.
reviews.reopen: Select exact current source/consumer to qualify representative/native gap; source folders and themed owners never prove behavior.
